questions.question: What year did the original Disneyland first open?
What date did Disneyland officially open to the public?

decision: The exact opening-date answer in q683 contains the entire 1955 year fact requested here. Preserve the broader year-only question. q683’s wording incorrectly says public opening for the invitation day; record that separate context concern, do not silently approve the replacement.

evidence.locator: Opening sentence explicitly distinguishes invitation opening July 17, 1955 and public opening the next day.
